info.title: Adzbyte App API
info.description: Versioned commerce and customer-management API. Adzbyte App is the system of record; adzbyte-next consumes approved storefront contracts.

get.description: Verified customer web session and authenticated ownership. No bearer fallback. Bodyless/queryless GET; queryless JSON object POST limited to 4096 bytes requires exact Origin, real CSRF, actor-scoped Idempotency-Key UUID and current order revision. Only open approved unexpired unpaid requests may start. Same command replays current attempt without POSTing again; changed input or new command conflicts. Ambiguous provider results remain unknown and prohibit automatic recreation. Only test mode is enabled. Neither checkout creation nor return redirect confirms payment.

get.description: Verified web session only; no service bearer fallback. Exact Origin and real CSRF are required for writes. Actor-scoped UUID and expected revision/version reject retries with changed input and stale commands. Management requires fresh Admin role and exact capabilities (View for order detail/actions). Customers are queried by authenticated ownership; only public messages count in their conversation. Bodyless GET; page is the only query on review/list reads, fixed page size 20. Settings accepts no query. Responses are private no-store. Approval never records payment.

post.summary: Mint a one-use 60-second View Cart transfer
post.description: Requires cart:handoff and independent cart proof. The fixed destination is the app cart landing page. Mint retries recover the same active unused capability; expired/consumed/pruned/rotated issuance requires a new UUID and never revives the old token. No customer is attached and cart items do not expire.

parameters.description: Same durable per-cart UUID only for an identical command. Never reuse an issuance UUID for another operation.

post.summary: Atomically consume a transfer into the app guest session
post.description: Uses web/session/CSRF middleware. The nonce-CSP landing page clears the token fragment, then posts same-origin JSON. Success rotates the app session/CSRF and grants only this cart. Replay/expiry/revoked issuer/changed cart authority/key rotation fail closed. On a lost consume response, a fresh View Cart link can recover the unchanged persistent cart. No supplied owner/reference/hash/redirect is accepted.

post.summary: Claim or explicitly merge the trusted guest cart into the verified account
post.description: Fresh verified customer, exact app Origin, web session, real CSRF, UUID and current keyed preview fingerprint. Restricted-category conflicts require customer choices; regular items survive and duplicate products remain quantity one. Existing quoted versions are preserved for current-offer review. Receipt binds source, guest authority, actor, UUID, state and choices. Original guest proof/links are revoked; authorized retry returns current active account cart. No expiry, payable order or payment is created. Login/activation automatically claim only nonconflicting selections; conflicts resume this workflow.

sanctumBearer.description: Revocable Laravel Sanctum personal access token.

storefrontBearer.description: Actual revocable Sanctum personal token for a verified service identity with no roles/direct permissions. Only cart:create, cart:read, cart:write and cart:handoff abilities are permitted; wildcard/excessive scopes and session fallback are forbidden. Each operation requires its named ability.

cartProof.name: X-Cart-Proof
cartProof.description: Server-generated 32-byte guest proof encoded as 64 lowercase hex characters. Required independently of the service token. Never place this proof in URLs or browser JavaScript.

appCartSession.name: adzbyte-session
appCartSession.description: Laravel server web session. Guest context comes only from valid handoff consumption; owned context requires a fresh verified customer identity and active-cart link. Registration/landing may initialize a session before a cart grant. Cookie name is configurable via SESSION_COOKIE.

appCsrf.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
appCsrf.description: CSRF value from the app landing page meta tag/current app session. Required for app-session mutations; a Bearer token/cart proof is not a substitute.

appWebSession.name: adzbyte-session
appWebSession.description: Server-side Laravel web session initialized by the registration bootstrap/form. Cookie name is configurable via SESSION_COOKIE. This does not imply verified identity or cart ownership.

checkout_url.description: Only the exact validated current PayMongo session URL; null when unsafe or unavailable. A redirect does not confirm payment.
